Inspected upstream StarEmbed source at https://github.com/skai-institute/StarEmbed/blob/master/src/datasets/ZTF/build_split.py (blob SHA 89253d4079cc7242c887b1082d32367eed0d3932) and dataset guide https://github.com/skai-institute/StarEmbed/blob/master/src/datasets/ZTF/README.md (blob SHA a08fd43de6756c67e148947bed112fb772e4d4db). The builder loads hf_csdr1_raw4_catflags_filtered_with_labels_multiband, applies a one-to-one flattening map, then performs two row-wise Hugging Face train_test_split calls stratified by class with seed 42; it does not deduplicate or group by sourceid. This is a confirmed leakage mechanism if duplicate sourceids exist before splitting, but it does not prove whether the two observed records were duplicated in the pre-split dataset or elsewhere in the upstream pipeline. That provenance remains unresolved.

root_causes: The first real-data audit exposed one train/test SourceID overlap and one duplicate SourceID within train; the current status logic did not treat these as blocking leakage.
Ruff RUF046 flagged redundant int casts in the new audit module
Ruff I001 flagged import ordering in the new test module
The first programmatic CI workflow edit placed part of the inserted shell block incorrectly; a subsequent full-file reconstruction from the main-branch workflow corrected the placement.

The fail-closed source audit returned exit code 2 for confirmed object-ID integrity findings, and because the step was not continue-on-error the pytest step was skipped; this was a CI sequencing defect, not a reason to weaken the scientific gate.

The default success() condition on the pytest step still skipped tests after a continue-on-error source audit step returned a failing outcome; explicit always() with successful dependency-install guards is now used.
The previous evidence upload included all five raw Parquet artifacts, creating a ~432 MB artifact per run; upload now targets only the compact audit JSON.
failure_analysis.impact: The source audit correctly blocked the Test Suite job for real-data integrity findings, but pytest and its report upload were skipped in the same run. The follow-up workflow change is intended to run tests and preserve an explicit failing audit gate.
failure_analysis.correction: Keep the StarEmbed audit BLOCKED and fail the job explicitly after tests. Run pytest despite a blocked audit only when dependency installation and pip check succeeded; upload only schema_audit.json with source hashes and diagnostics. Verify latest-head CI and inspect the new artifact before claiming completion.

findings: A schema audit is not a classifier benchmark; model inference and performance evaluation remain separate blocked work.
A successful scientific-validation contract job does not imply source-backed data acquisition occurred when acquisition jobs were skipped.
CI findings must be repaired and the new commit's workflow results checked before asserting resolution.
